# Plans & Pricing

## Essentials

$19 per agent / month, billed annually

- Email and chat support
- 2 help centers

## Growth

$49 per agent / month, billed annually

- Everything in Essentials
- AI reply suggestions (1,000 per month)
- SLA policies

## Scale

$99 per agent / month, billed annually

- Unlimited AI replies
- Sandbox and audit log

*Prices effective October 15, 2026.*
